criteria.requirement: Space, percent, Unicode and slash-escaped URL names
criteria.evidence: Fresh actual Foundation copy test covers decoded Unicode/space/percent names, NSURL lastPathComponent for a slash-escaped original and a readable staged path that cannot be replaced by original URI metadata. Seven unchanged actual native path/name methods reused.

criteria.requirement: Readable iOS temp-copy path after original expires
criteria.evidence: Controlled deletion of the actual original succeeds; staged copy path still exists and exact binary read passes. URI restoration points to the deleted original, not a fictitious copy. This proves local original unavailability, not cloud grant expiry or OS purging; those remain IO-008/IO-013/IO-019 gates.

Fresh Android-host five actual Robolectric Uri cases distinguish content null filesystem path from decoded file path and URI/plain-path restoration. External grants and cross-process provider lifetime are not claimed.

criteria.requirement: Two browser files with identical names
criteria.evidence: Fresh real Chrome JS and Wasm File/FileReader test uses identical Unicode/percent names with distinct bytes, concurrent/repeated reads, truthful null path/URI/restoration and overload parity. Older extensionless-name test was not duplicate-name evidence.

criteria.requirement: Round-trip URI serialization independent of path
criteria.evidence: Fresh desktop URI round-trip and Android-host restoration plus fresh native original/copy distinction; three unchanged real native URI restoration and two non-file/local-path isolation methods reused. getPath semantic migration and toUriString are explicit in IO.md.
